item.title: 7 Decades Later, the Most Satisfying Movie of All Time Is Free on YouTube
item.description: 12 Angry Men begins at the very end of a trial, just as the jury is about to go deliberate. This is a murder case where a son is being accused of stabbing his father to death. The judge reminds the jury of their duty, and that the sentence for this person, if convicted, will be death. Silently, the young man who barely looks to be out of high school looks at the jury and a couple of members look back. Then the jury goes off into the jury room.

item.title: I Can't Wait to Ignore the Main Story of GTA 6
item.description: It's hard to believe, but after years of waiting, we're less than a week away from the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . Tons of people are planning to take time off from work or school in order to sink their teeth into Rockstar's newest adventure. Many of them will be diving headfirst into Jason and Lucia's story, taking on high-stakes robberies to see how the couple's ascent through Vice City's underworld plays out. But for me, the "grand theft auto" of GTA 6 is actually the least intriguing element of 2026's most anticipated game. I couldn't care less about shooting people and stealing cars. I'm far more excited to explore the vast, glorious sandbox Rockstar has created.

item.title: 8 Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Miniseries that Hook You in the First Episode
item.description: Sci-fi stories are a dime a dozen, but very few genre stories manage to make an unforgettable impact with the miniseries format. This makes sense. Shows like The Expanse or Westworld need more space to flesh out their multi-season storylines. That said, some sci-fi miniseries accomplish a lot with less. Whether you’re looking for an action-packed show or one that is more philosophical in tone, these eight entries make for a near-perfect viewing experience that can be wrapped up in just a few days.

item.title: Tomb Raider Remake Gameplay Changes Are Dividing Fans
item.description: Amazon Game Studios has released the sixth installment in its behind-the-scenes series about the development of Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis . The remake of Lara Croft's original 1996 adventure is set to be released next year and will update the game for modern players. While that includes graphical improvements, the new video details gameplay changes and not everybody is happy about what was shown off.

item.title: Forget Ganon, Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Most Overlooked Boss Finally Gets Its Due
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is iconic for plenty of reasons, but a big part of that is thanks to its villain. Ganondorf is one of gaming’s great bad guys, a reputation that has only been enhanced by appearances in later games like Wind Waker and Tears of the Kingdom . While Ocarina of Time ’s Switch 2 remake does the Demon King justice, it’s also a reminder that the Zelda series has another excellent, and far more underappreciated, foe: Twinrova.

item.title: 9 Giant-Sized Changes Marvel Made to Ant-Man After Edgar Wright Left
item.description: As Wright has explained in interviews, he was excited to be on the ground floor of something, setting the tone for what the MCU would become. He wanted to do a superhero movie where it was still emblematic of the director, in keeping with their body of work. The comparison he’d made was Tim Burton’s Batman , which is still very much a Tim Burton movie. After leaving Ant-Man , Wright even told Variety , “I wanted to make a Marvel movie but I don’t think they really wanted to make an Edgar Wright movie.”

item.title: Stephen King’s Underrated 1980 Horror Thriller Gets New Prime Video Adaptation
item.description: Stephen King fans are eating well, with Mike Flanagan's adaptation of Carrie turning out to be a surprise hit, a second season of It: Welcome to Derry on the way, and a series based on The Dark Tower books in the works. But that's not all King fans can look forward to.
